name: Not Telling The Truth
overview: Scripture firmly establishes that God is truth itself, unchanging and incapable of lying, as Numbers 23:19 affirms. Lying is detestable to the Lord, described as an abomination in Proverbs 12:22 and linked to the character of the devil, who is called the father of lies in John 8:44. Believers are called to speak truth to one another and uphold justice and peace through truth, as emphasized in Zechariah 8:16, knowing that embracing truth leads to freedom, according to John 8:32.
